description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing FastCGI backend processes and extensions in the lighttpd web server.

methods.name: gw_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new backend context.

methods.name: gw_plugin_config_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a gw_plugin_config structure.

methods.name: gw_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for backend data.

methods.name: gw_exts_clear_check_local
methods.description: Clears check_local flags in gw_exts structures.

methods.name: gw_set_defaults_backend
methods.description: Sets default backend configuration for a server.

methods.name: gw_check_extension
methods.description: Checks and handles extension matching for a request.

methods.name: gw_set_transparent
methods.description: Sets transparent mode for a handler context.

methods.name: gw_upgrade_policy
methods.description: Determines if a request should be upgraded.

methods.name: gw_incremental_policy
methods.description: Determines if a request should be incrementally upgraded.
